method.scope: 128MiB workspace, complete native fresh invocation, 3 warmups + 9 single-call samples/process; 3 rotating processes/format/window, 2 windows. BPI2/BPC1/BPI3 recorded separately. Build and input generation excluded and not claimed as producer timing.

verdict: Large product/variant projections and sequence consumption show strong complete-native-path gains with much lower allocation traffic. Tiny/1KiB projections still lose latency, and several small sequence cases have higher peak working allocation. These unresolved differences are not hidden by the large-value gains.
